revealed.name: Pinglet
revealed.desc: Pinglet is a penguin chick in a red scarf that waves at everyone it meets.

revealed.name: Pyrraven
revealed.desc: Pyrraven is a huge black raven with flames along its wings and a chest that glows brighter as the sun goes down.

revealed.name: Dribbara
revealed.desc: Dribbara is a capybara pup with a little sprout of water bubbling up from the top of its head.

revealed.name: Lunarca
revealed.desc: Lunarca is a pale whale whose head rises into a cratered dome like a full moon.

revealed.name: Spanglin
revealed.desc: Spanglin is a pink pangolin pup with scales like tiny mirrors, and it curls into a ball whenever it is nervous, which is often.

revealed.name: Blastopuff
revealed.desc: Blastopuff's spines have grown into a burst of long golden spikes, like a firework caught mid-bang.

revealed.name: Lanterloris
revealed.desc: A slow loris that is a paper lantern: its belly glows, and when it is scared it floats up like a balloon. Soft-spoken, sleepy by day, wide awake at night; clings to you when frightened.

revealed.name: Glaciatee
revealed.desc: Glaciatee is a huge maned sea beast with a crown of ice, long clear tusks and a cloak of aurora light.

revealed.name: Fawnshroom
revealed.desc: Fawnshroom is a fawn whose big floppy ears are dappled mushroom caps.

revealed.name: Forgebrock
revealed.desc: Forgebrock rears up like a bear, with the anvil still on its back and a chest that burns like an open furnace.

revealed.name: Jerbit
revealed.desc: Jerbit is a grey jerboa with a spring for a tail and a tuft at the end that crackles with static.

revealed.name: Dreadmonite
revealed.desc: Dreadmonite is a giant ammonite with a riveted shell like the hull of a battleship.

revealed.name: Vespox
revealed.desc: A fox with a scorpion's pincers and sting tail.

revealed.name: Lunowl
revealed.desc: A moonlit owl with soft moth wings. It flits on moondust and dazzles foes with silver light.

revealed.name: Rampartoad
revealed.desc: A toad with a castle wall on its back; sit behind it and nothing gets through, and it pulls stones out of itself to throw. Placid, heavy, a creature of habit; croaks once, deeply, when it disapproves.

revealed.name: Seamwyrm
revealed.desc: Seamwyrm is a black serpent dragon whose zipper has split open into great jaws that glow purple inside.

revealed.name: Duskargot
revealed.desc: A snail whose shell is smoked obsidian glass. It drinks the light around it and leaves a trail of dusk behind.

revealed.name: Glomwort
revealed.desc: A yellow slime mold that creeps like a net and fruits little puffballs. Step on one and the spores hold you fast.

revealed.name: Crofthorn
revealed.desc: A highland cow with a walled garden on its back; you ride sitting on the garden wall. Gentle and stubborn, grazes mid-fight; bellows proudly when you climb on.

revealed.name: Skidlet
revealed.desc: Skidlet is a fluffy lilac heron chick that glides about happily on tiny skate blades.

revealed.name: Anvilbrock
revealed.desc: A honey badger with a red-hot anvil for a back; it headbutts you and the anvil rings. Fearless and grumpy; picks fights it cannot win and wins them.

revealed.name: Marchleaf
revealed.desc: A leafcutter ant hauling a leaf ten times its size, with a column of tiny workers marching behind. It never stops working.

revealed.name: Murmurling
revealed.desc: A starling with pan-pipes for a tail; every note it plays flies off as another tiny bird. Sociable, noisy, lonely in a second; mimics your footsteps.

revealed.name: Nettlynx
revealed.desc: A lynx kitten whose ear tufts and tail are stinging nettle. Pet it the wrong way and you'll know.

revealed.name: Bubblisk
revealed.desc: A lizard that blows a soap-bubble copy of itself and runs while you pop the bubble. A show-off that startles easily; runs first, poses later.

revealed.name: Chuggamus
revealed.desc: A hippo that is half steam engine: smokestack ears, a boiler belly, a cowcatcher jaw, and it charges like a runaway train. Lazy until crossed, then unstoppable; yawns steam at you to say it likes you.

revealed.name: Thrumbird
revealed.desc: A hummingbird whose forked tail rings like a tuning fork. Its hum steadies your aim and rattles your foes.

revealed.name: Oarlet
revealed.desc: Oarlet is an otter pup with a little paddle for a tail.

revealed.name: Lanternmit
revealed.desc: Lanternmit is a Jarmit that moved into an old oil lantern and took on its glow, right down to the flames on its claw tips.

revealed.name: Stormit
revealed.desc: Stormit is a Jarmit that moved into a bottle wrapped in wire coil, with a small storm trapped inside.

revealed.name: Terrarimit
revealed.desc: Terrarimit is a Jarmit that settled into a cracked glass globe full of ferns and never left.

revealed.name: Cairnback
revealed.desc: A tortoise with an ibex's sweeping horns, carrying a little rune-carved cairn on its shell. Hatched from the Stone Colossus's egg.

revealed.name: Hivara
revealed.desc: A honeybee with a praying mantis's folded blades, wearing a crown of wax. A swarm of tiny bees follows it everywhere.

revealed.name: Zephyrak
revealed.desc: A little sky serpent: a moray eel's long body with a swift's swept wings, crackling with static. Hatched from Stormcoil's egg.

revealed.name: Vespyx
revealed.desc: A sly fox with a scorpion's curled tail. Its sting drips venom that keeps eating at foes after the hit.

revealed.name: Mycroll
revealed.desc: A hedgehog whose quills are glowing toadstools. It puffs spore clouds that root foes where they stand.

revealed.name: Prismander
revealed.desc: An axolotl whose frills grew into living crystal. It bends light into shields and dazzling beams.

revealed.name: Kitlet
revealed.desc: Kitlet is a cream dragonet with a little red paper kite on its back.

revealed.name: Kestrike
revealed.desc: A kestrel with a copper crest that draws lightning. It hangs still in the wind, then strikes like the bolt it caught.

revealed.name: Lockatara
revealed.desc: A lizard with a padlock shackle for a crest and a keyhole for a third eye; its tail is the key. Ancient, calm, faintly amused; watches you through the keyhole when you are not looking.

revealed.name: Geyserbara
revealed.desc: Geyserbara is a big capybara marked with teal rings, and steam puffs from the vents along its back.

revealed.name: Dreadnoyak
revealed.desc: Dreadnoyak is a colossal black yak with a skull for a face and the calf's ice hull grown into an icebreaker's iron bow under its chest.

revealed.name: Gemole
revealed.desc: Gemole rears up on its hind legs with two amethyst gauntlets the size of its own head.

revealed.name: Sabryx
revealed.desc: Sabryx is a wolf-sized hunter whose sting has hardened into a curved green scythe.

revealed.name: Voltalon
revealed.desc: Voltalon is a great thunder falcon, and lightning strikes twice as often anywhere near it.

revealed.name: Reapant
revealed.desc: Reapant is a Shinobant grown into a dark, hooded knight with wings and a scythe for each arm.

revealed.name: Phonodrake
revealed.desc: Phonodrake is a spotted dragon crowned with gramophone horns, each one pointing a different way.

revealed.name: Ringrove
revealed.desc: Ringrove is a big, calm hedgehog that lives under one giant teal mushroom cap of its own growing.

revealed.name: Eclipsowl
revealed.desc: Eclipsowl is a great dark owl that walks on four legs and wears a bright crescent on its brow.

revealed.name: Crystalotl
revealed.desc: Crystalotl has grown long and serpent-like, with a hood of clear glass that chimes softly as it moves.

revealed.name: Maulangler
revealed.desc: Maulangler has left the mud behind and walks about on stubby legs, a huge dark angler with a glowing purple mouth.

revealed.name: Candelapi
revealed.desc: Candelapi is a tall wax okapi crowned with a chandelier of antlers and purple candles, bright enough to light a meadow.

revealed.name: Thundrich
revealed.desc: Thundrich's body is a black thunderhead, topped with a crest of red quills that crackle with lightning.

revealed.name: Kitedrake
revealed.desc: Kitedrake is a great cream dragon with two huge red kite wings, grown from the little kite it wore as a Kitlet.

revealed.name: Crofthollow
revealed.desc: Crofthollow is a great highland bull with thatch and ripe wheat growing along its back and a tail like a tied sheaf.

revealed.name: Embermink
revealed.desc: Embermink is a Minkee whose brush caught fire and stayed lit, and its coat is covered in fiery strokes.

revealed.name: Canvastross
revealed.desc: An albatross with patched ship sails for wings; grab the rigging under it and it carries you across the gap. Easygoing, fearless, a wanderer; restless when it has not seen the sea.

revealed.name: Vaultara
revealed.desc: Vaultara is a huge tuatara whose shell has become a round vault door.

revealed.name: Gravidon
revealed.desc: Small stones drift in a slow ring around Gravidon, caught by a pull much stronger than the one it had as a Gravadillo.

revealed.name: Vatmander
revealed.desc: Vatmander has left barrels behind and now carries its water in a cluster of glass orbs on its back, with lightning marks down its sides.

revealed.name: Lanceron
revealed.desc: Lanceron is a tall heron with wings of ice feathers and a beak as long as a lance.

revealed.name: Mortarfly
revealed.desc: Mortarfly climbs out of the marble cocoon as a moth with brass-ribbed wings and a calm stone face.
